summary: This video details two high-performing Ice Blast team compositions against the Season 8 endgame boss Mekkatorque. The primary setup using Anselmo as support can achieve up to 1.8 billion damage when fully optimized with Inspiration 5. A second variation replaces Anselmo with Felosia for a resistance-focused build. The video covers hero builds, stat priorities, artifacts, and skill rotation timing for both setups.

heroes.name: Beldelle
heroes.note: Must have the highest Attack in the team to receive the pet's 10% Attack buff; focus on Attack and Crit Rate.

heroes.name: Fredegonda
heroes.note: Build with Crit Rate, Crit Damage, and Puppeteer set; functions well even at Inspiration 0.

heroes.name: Shinnah
heroes.note: Requires high Attack along with sufficient Accuracy and Resistance.

heroes.name: Ernesto
heroes.note: Build with high Attack and Healing talent to sustain the team.

heroes.name: Anselmo
heroes.note: Equipped with Secrecy set and Skill Haste to align skills to a 17.2-second rotation.

heroes.name: Felosia
heroes.note: Built with high Resistance and Prismatic Cloak to reflect debuffs back to the boss.

teams.note: Anselmo support setup capable of dealing up to 1.8 billion damage with a 17.2s skill rotation.
Felosia resistance setup utilizing Prismatic Cloak for debuff reflection and higher team survivability.

tips: Ensure Beldelle has the highest Attack stat in the team so the pet grants her the bonus 10% Attack.
Use HP regeneration talents on DPS heroes to ensure survivability without relying on a second pure healer.
If Fredegonda lacks her exclusive artifact, alternative Attack-boosting options like Orb of the Dragon Blood or Antlers can be used.
title: Best Ice Blast Teams vs Mekkatorque | S8 Endgame Boss Phase 1 | Dragonheir
